reviewer: Claude (independent, read-only source review; no edits to candidate sources)
subject: T8103 parked first-entry experiment, candidate revision 6
verdict_scope: Only the pre-VM console-and-park experiment. This is not a review of, or claim about, a continuing kernel, normal boot, VM/IOKit initialization or app support.

entry_and_park: Kernel links with -e __start; __start and start_first_cpu both branch to darwin_lab_m1_first_entry (start.s), so neither cold entry reaches normal VM initialization.
First instruction masks DAIF (0xd5034fdf), including the wrong-EL refusal path; then EL1 (CurrentEL==4), SCTLR_EL1.M==0 and MIDR Apple 0x61 part 0x022/0x023 checks.
x0 (boot_args) is never written; no stack or writable globals; PC-relative addressing only; VBAR_EL1 set to LowExceptionVectorBase, a 4 KiB-aligned table of b . spin vectors.

UART constants match pinned m1n1: base 0x235200000 (src/soc.h), UTRSTAT +0x10 TXBE bit1 / TXE bit2, UTXH +0x20, 32-bit accesses (src/uart_regs.h, src/uart.c); bounded polling; unconditional self-loop park with no WFI, return or fallthrough.
MACHINE_FLAGS_ARM64_T8103 always defines DARWIN_LAB_M1_FIRSTBOOT=1 and CMake refuses non-DEBUG T8103, so no T8103 build of this candidate omits the park.

unsupported_failstop_aliases.assessment: Explicit nonreturning fail-closed guards for public-source-absent Apple cache/HID helpers, not success stubs and not a cache implementation. Unreachable from the parked path: the entry routine contains no calls, and callers (caches_asm.s APPLE_ARM64_ARCH_FAMILY path, osfmk/arm/pmap/pmap.c around 11044-11076) run only after VM initialization. No duplicate definition: the portable _nohid exists only under !APPLE_ARM64_ARCH_FAMILY (caches_asm.s:368-369).

security_backend_omissions.reason: Private CoreEntitlements V2 types and CTRR register definitions are absent from the public source; no placeholder types or layouts were invented.
security_backend_omissions.note: KERNEL_CTRR_VERSION remains defined while KERNEL_INTEGRITY_CTRR is undefined; harmless for the parked image, must be resolved by any continuing kernel.

findings.public_source_selection: MASTER.arm64.t8103 (selected by doconf only for SoC t8103) equals the pinned MacOSX master except nos_arm_pmap nos_arm_asm in ARM_EXTRAS_BASE and removal of optional sched_hygiene_debug.
findings.scheduler_preemption_check: With sched_hygiene_debug removed (VIRT master precedent), osfmk/arm/pmap/pmap.h:776-780 selects the public inline _pmap_pending_preemption_real AST_URGENT check instead of the undefined external debug wrapper. Cost: DEBUG scheduler-hygiene timeout diagnostics are off.

assembler_register_aliases.assessment: Assembler-only, experiment-gated encodings inferred from identical XNU/m1n1 field layouts and operations; scratch assembly with pinned clang 21.1.8 produced the expected MRS/MSR encodings. The instructions are unreachable in the parked image.

findings.packet_binding: tools/m1_firstboot.py binds the packet source patch to the reviewed patch hash, binds kernel and m1n1 build receipts, and verifies the __start symbol, the LC_UNIXTHREAD entry branch target and the diagnostic instruction prefix.

non_blocking_notes: Describe any successful link as a native T8103 link with four fail-stop cache placeholders, PMAP_CS/XNU_MONITOR/CTRR omitted and scheduler-hygiene diagnostics off, not as a complete kernel. Root reports its final inspector now validates the linked fail-stop bindings and three instructions.
Optional: a distinctive brk before the fail-stop self-loop would panic identifiably instead of hanging if ever reached after VM initialization.
limits: Source-only review. The reviewer did not build, link, inspect a linked build-006 artifact, contact hardware, use SSH or run a guest.
Register aliases are inferences from m1n1 encodings plus matching fields and operations, not Apple headers.

m1n1 hypervisor caveats remain: VUART UTRSTAT always reports TXBE|TXE, so polling/timeout is untested in that route; VPIDR_EL2 and guest SCTLR_EL1 are not set by pinned m1n1; host break-in after the masked park is unverified; the installed stage2 is not the pinned m1n1.
No runtime evidence exists. Only a captured HVLOG line plus the expected parked state would support the entry checkpoint.
